svg.title: Fit-test coupon, cut 1 from the wall sheet
svg.desc: Bit: 6.350 mm (0.250 in) - set this on Origin. Cut types: exterior @ 12.50 mm deep x1, interior @ 12.50 mm deep x1. Geometry is the finished part size; Origin applies the bit offset. Colours per notes/shaper-svg.md (Shaper cut type encoding). shaper:cutDepth is a target and over-depth check; set the cut depth on Origin yourself. Material thickness: 12.00 mm (PLACEHOLDER - NOT MEASURED, do not cut good stock). Through-cut depth: 12.50 mm (thickness + 0.5 mm overcut). Corner reliefs: dogbone, sized for the 6.35 mm bit. A different bit needs a re-run. Panel orientation doesn't matter: every notch and slot goes right through.
